results.title: FIFA chief Infantino's position looks unacceptable, head of European leagues says
results.description: European Leagues chief Claudius Schaefer said Gianni Infantino's FIFA presidency is untenable after the failed World Cup rights plan, citing poor governance and no consultation.

results.title: Taiwan Open 2026: Aaron Chia-Aaron Tai finish as runners-up
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR: National men’s doubles pair, Aaron Chia-Aaron Tai, finished as runners-up at the Taiwan Open 2026 after a hard-fought final today. The fifth-seeded Malaysian duo lost in straight sets to Indonesia’s eighth seeds, Leo Rolly Carnando-Daniel Marthin, with scores of 21-23, 19-21.
